newsitem.title: INDIA: Two killed in Kashmir bomb blast.
newsitem.headline: Two killed in Kashmir bomb blast.

text.p: A bomb blast killed two people and wounded one on Wednesday in the troubled Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir, police said.
They said a bomb planted by suspected separatist guerrillas exploded in Bijbehara village, 45 km (27 miles) south of Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir.

No one has claimed responsibility for the blast. More than a dozen guerrilla groups have been waging a separatist revolt in the region since 1990. Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have died in insurgency-related violence.
Thirty-two people were injured on Tuesday in two separate grenade attacks at crowded places in the Kashmir Valley, police said.
